records.reason: The byte-bound actual SVG correctly distinguishes the requested region: the six vertex sectors are white and the central region is purple. Its six nested Clip1 through Clip6 masks remove the sector interiors from the filled hexagon. The first pass and targeted audit repeated a false same-fill visual premise; it is not a source defect. Joining the center to the six vertices gives six equilateral triangles of side 6, each of height 3*sqrt(3) and area 9*sqrt(3), for total area 54*sqrt(3). Each radius-3 vertex sector has angle 120 degrees and area 3*pi. Adjacent radius-3 disks meet only at the midpoint of their length-6 side; other center separations exceed 6. Thus the sector interiors do not overlap. Subtracting six sector areas gives 54*sqrt(3)-18*pi, C. Preserve all mathematical roles, the answer check and normal grading; remove only the false active figure warning.

records.reason: The actual sphere is inscribed against both parallel bases and the conical side. Let R>r>0 be the base radii and s the sphere radius. The axial tangent trapezoid has height 2*s and each sloping leg R+r. Pythagoras gives (R+r)^2=(R-r)^2+4*s^2, hence s^2=R*r. Subtracting the two similar cone volumes gives (2*pi*s/3)*(R^2+R*r+r^2). Comparing with twice the sphere volume 4*pi*s^3/3 yields R^2-3*R*r+r^2=0. Therefore R/r=(3+sqrt(5))/2, E. The exact root-approved sphere-volume node and current axial-tangents/cone-difference route already cover this work. Preserve that mapped resolution and empty gap fields. The recovered audit used old scope definitions and cannot restore an obsolete unresolved state.

records.reason: The actual figure fixes the upward arrow, external starting tangency at 12 oclock and clockwise orbital motion. Under the ordinary no-slip rolling model, let theta be the clockwise orbital angle. Equal contact arcs give disk turn relative to the line of centers (20/10)*theta=2*theta. The line of centers itself turns theta, so the fixed-frame arrow turns 3*theta. Its first positive upward return is one full turn, at theta=120 degrees clockwise, or 4 oclock, C. The exact root-approved external-circle-rolling node explicitly covers the distinction between moving-frame and fixed-frame turns. Preserve the complete equal-contact-arcs/frame-turn route and the existing no-slip interpretation qualification. The recovered old-catalog scope gap is already resolved; this is not a grading ambiguity.
